name: us-life-tables
title: United States life tables, 2023 and 2024
summary: Actuarial calculations with the US life tables of 2023 and 2024: survival, expectation of life, joint lives, insurance and annuity values, net premiums and reserves, and checks of the tables against themselves.
description: Each task hands the AI the 36 complete period life tables that the National Center for Health Statistics published for 2023 and 2024, and the AI has to pick the right one by year, population and sex. The question states its facts, formulas and conventions, such as the interest rate and how to treat ages 100 and over. The AI gives exact answers: a probability, an expectation of life, a present value, a net premium or reserve, a column rebuilt from another, or something it finds in the tables. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

families.name: Survival probability
families.what: The chance of surviving or dying over several years or a deferred period, with an extra mortality where one is stated.

families.name: Expectation of life
families.what: Complete, curtate and temporary expectations of life, and the median and most common ages at death.

families.name: Fractional ages
families.what: Probabilities between whole ages, under uniform deaths and under a constant force of mortality.

families.name: Joint lives
families.what: Probabilities and expectations for the first and the second death of two independent lives.

families.name: Insurance value
families.what: Present values of pure endowments, term, whole life and endowment insurances at a stated interest rate.

families.name: Annuity value
families.what: Present values of whole life, temporary, deferred and guaranteed annuities paid at the start of each year.

families.name: Premiums and reserves
families.what: Net level annual premiums, and net premium reserves under the equivalence principle.

families.name: Column rebuild
families.what: One column of a table rebuilt from another and checked against it at the precision the report prints.

families.name: Table comparison
families.what: Men against women, 2024 against 2023, and five populations against each other.

families.name: Table check
families.what: A table checked against itself, and how the files label the ages and the last age group.
